title: A Portal Special Presentation- Geometric Unity: A First Look
summary: Eric Weinstein's roughly three-hour presentation of Geometric Unity, his proposed theory unifying physics, given as a special episode of The Portal. It includes clarifications at the end.
why: HN uses it as the primary source for Weinstein's theory, though some commenters note he never published a full math paper.

quote.text: his original lecture detailing the Geometric Unity model he discussed on Rogan
